findings.page: List of Figures (PDF p. 8–10, printed p. iv–vi)
findings.evidence: List of Figures prints: 'P.1 The architect's decision loop — the book's spine . . . xii'; '2.2 Prefill and decode split by the roofline ridge . . . . . 31' [sic — actual page 32]; '6.1 The metric hierarchy as a diagnostic chain [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION] . . . . . . . 125'; '7.1 Grouped-Query Attention cuts per-token KV . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 151'. In the rendered body the Figure 2.2 caption appears on the page displaying '31' (PDF p. 52); the Figure 6.1 caption appears on the page displaying '124' (PDF p. 144); the Figure 7.1 caption appears on the page displaying '150' (PDF p. 153); the Preface Figure P.1 caption appears on the page displaying 'xii' but the figure content spans the prior page displaying 'xii' [sic — confirmed on PDF p. 16].
findings.issue: The List of Figures page index is systematically off by one for at least the entries P.1, 2.2, 4.1, 5.1, 6.1, 6.2, 7.1, 7.2, 7.5, 7.7, 7.8 (and likely many others in chapters 8–26): each entry points to the page AFTER the one on which the figure and its caption actually appear. Earlier entries (1.1 at p. 10, 1.2 at p. 11, 2.1 at p. 19, P.2 at p. xiii) are correct, so the index is internally inconsistent — a reader using it to navigate will consistently land one page too late for many figures. The TOC introduction also promises 'Every figure the book numbers' as an accurate index.
findings.fix_instruction: Decrement every affected page number in the List of Figures by 1 (or re-derive all entries from the typesetting source) so each entry matches the page on which the figure's caption actually falls. Re-run the check for every entry after the typeset layout changes.

findings.page: List of Tables (PDF p. 11–12, printed p. vii–viii)
findings.evidence: List of Tables prints: 'Table 2-2 Decode bandwidth and prefill FLOPs . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 25'; 'Table 7-1 KV cache size per token and per-context arithmetic … 144'; 'Table 7-2 Memory floors by regime … 154'; 'Table 7-3 Frontier 2026 KV-scheme claims … 167'. In the rendered body Table 2-2's header row '2.3.1. Table 2-2 — Decode bandwidth and prefill FLOPs' appears on the page displaying '24' (PDF p. 45) with the first data row on the page displaying '25' (PDF p. 46). Table 7-1's header 'Table 7-1 — KV cache size per token…' appears on the page displaying '145' (PDF p. 166); Table 7-2's header appears on the page displaying '155' (PDF p. 176); Table 7-3's header appears on the page displaying '166' (PDF p. 187).
findings.issue: The List of Tables page index is off by one for at least Tables 2-2, 7-1, 7-2 and 7-3: each entry points to the page AFTER the one on which the table header actually appears (2-2 → 25 but header at 24/25 boundary; 7-1 → 144 but header at 145; 7-2 → 154 but header at 155; 7-3 → 167 but header at 166). Earlier entries (1-1 at 12, 2-1 at 21, 3-1 at 44) are correct, so the index is internally inconsistent — same class of defect as the List of Figures.
findings.fix_instruction: Re-derive every page number in the List of Tables from the typesetting source so each entry matches the page on which the table's header row actually falls. Verify after every layout change; do not leave any entry unchecked.
